# CLAUDE.md

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before making changes in this repo.

Also read `CLAUDE.local.md` when it exists. That file is local, private, and ignored by git.

---

## Do Not Edit This Baseline File

**Under no circumstances edit `CLAUDE.md` or the other baseline file in this project.** These files are the shared agents baseline, copied in from the upstream agents repo, and any edits here are overwritten on the next sync.

- For project-specific rules that should be shared and committed, use `agent-context/`.
- For local, private, machine-specific notes, use `CLAUDE.local.md` (git-ignored).

Change the baseline itself only in the upstream agents repo, not here.
